heading_path: Public Accountability, Notice, Consent, and Feedback
sections.text: There should be a single, high-level official that is solely responsible for the success or failure of AI in FCCPS. That official must have the following three qualities. First, they must have an enterprise-level view of the school system, since AI-related concerns cover a breadth of domains (learning outcomes, academic integrity, mental health, privacy, acquisitions, tech support, etc.). Second, they must be empowered to approve or veto AI-related actions; oversight responsibility without authority is a recipe for organizational failure. Third, their position must have relatively low turnover to avoid the moral hazard of their successor being blamed for the faults of the predecessor.
